profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dominion Capital LLC
profile.summary: Hello! I'm a software engineer who likes to build innovative solutions for real-world problems. I'm currently Full Stack Developer at Handshake helping employers and students meet their hiring aspirations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained a web app for managing real estate deal flows, loan payments (manual and
ACH) and asset management.
- Supported more than 100% increase in total loan lending volume year over year.
- Used Ruby on Rails, Stimulus, Python, Bootstrap, Mysql, Redis, Nginx and Docker
- Built a chat bot that integrates with mysql database, summarizes PDFs and summarizes webpage
contents using OpenAI’s models.
- Communicated with CEO to define and refine requirements with organizational goals in mind.
- Used Ruby on Rails, Stimulus, NodeJS, Python, Bootstrap, Mysql, Redis, Nginx and Docker.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · Engineering · Ruby on Rails · AJAX · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · MySQL

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Planned and executed feature that employers use to find top ranked candidates based on the job's needs.
- 17% increase in employers who sent a message.
- 63% increase in employers who sent a message to a candidate from the matches experience.
- Integrated with third party API to sync user data using the publish-subscribe messaging pattern.
- Completed a rehaul of form that employers use to post jobs.
- Used Ruby on Rails, React, Typescript, Redux, Graphql, Bigtable, Redis and Postgresql.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Apollo GraphQL · PostgreSQL · React.js · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Ruby on Rails Developer
positions.description:
· Followed extreme programming and test driven programming.
· Participated in user interviews to understand requirements and guide direction of development.
· Used Ruby on Rails, React, Typescript, PostgreSQL, Jenkins and Pivotal Cloud Foundry.
